name: rallyorm
description: ORM for Rally API. Simplifies integration and management of Rally entities in Node.js with modern async/await patterns.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.test-typecheck.json --noEmit && rimraf .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && mocha ".test-dist/test/unit/**/*.js"
scripts.test:live: npm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.test-typecheck.json --noEmit && rimraf .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && mocha ".test-dist/test/integration/**/*.js" --reporter spec
scripts.coverage:badges: npm run coverage && mocha ".test-dist/test/unit/**/*.js" --reporter json --reporter-option output=coverage/mocha.json && node scripts/coverage-badges.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && node test/smoke/package-consumer.mjs && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release:check:live: cross-env RALLY_INTEGRATION=1 npm run release:check && cross-env RALLY_INTEGRATION=1 npm run test:live

author: Gonzalo López Membrive <irongete@gmail.com>
